tools.name: tiktok_username
tools.description: Resolve a TikTok handle to its public profile: display name, bio, avatar, verification, follower, like and video counts, and the permanent user ID. Without an API key: $0.05 USDC per successful call via x402 (Base or Solana).

tools.name: http_get
tools.description: Fetch any URL through our proxy and return the status, response headers and body (text bodies up to 128 KB). The request leaves from the proxy network, not the caller. Without an API key: $0.05 USDC per successful call via x402 (Base or Solana).

tools.name: onion_grab
tools.description: Fetch a .onion page over Tor and return its status, title, visible text and links (text only, no images). Given a clearnet URL instead, returns every .onion address that page links to or mentions. Without an API key: $0.05 USDC per successful call via x402 (Base or Solana).

tools.name: domain_urls
tools.description: Every URL captured on a domain in recent public web crawls - a passive way to enumerate a site's pages without touching the site. Returns the crawl id and the URLs with status, mime type and capture timestamp. Without an API key: $0.05 USDC per successful call via x402 (Base or Solana).

tools.name: cve_exploit

tools.name: http_screenshot

tools.name: domain_emails
tools.description: Every email address associated with a domain. Addresses only - nothing about the source is returned. Without an API key: $0.05 USDC per successful call via x402 (Base or Solana).

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: http_get, onion_grab, domain_urls, osint-email · Private data: tiktok_username, http_get, onion_grab, domain_urls, cve_exploit, domain_ips, http_screenshot, domain_emails, domain_whois, username_scanner, google_maps_search, facebook_profile, facebook_name_search, instagram_name_search, instagram_profile, snapchat_username, telegram_username, github_user, paypal_username, substack_lookup, uk_company_lookup, uk_officer_search, us_company_lookup, discord_lookup, discord_username, discord_tag, phone_lookup, whatsapp_business, gravatar_email, image_metadata, ip_lookup, ip_geolocation, ip_reputation, btc_address, eth_address, sol_address, tron_address, steam_profile, npi_lookup, vin_decode, br_cnpj, br_cep, br_cpf, br_ddd, discord_server_search, osint-email, osint-username, osint-phone, osint-domain, osint-origin · Public sink: domain_emails, domain_whois, instagram_profile, gravatar_email, osint-email · Destructive: substack_lookup, br_cpf.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: http_get, onion_grab, domain_urls, osint-email · Private data: tiktok_username, http_get, onion_grab, domain_urls, cve_exploit, domain_ips, http_screenshot, domain_emails, domain_whois, username_scanner, google_maps_search, facebook_profile, facebook_name_search, instagram_name_search, instagram_profile, snapchat_username, telegram_username, github_user, paypal_username, substack_lookup, uk_company_lookup, uk_officer_search, us_company_lookup, discord_lookup, discord_username, discord_tag, phone_lookup, whatsapp_business, gravatar_email, image_metadata, ip_lookup, ip_geolocation, ip_reputation, btc_address, eth_address, sol_address, tron_address, steam_profile, npi_lookup, vin_decode, br_cnpj, br_cep, br_cpf, br_ddd, discord_server_search, osint-email, osint-username, osint-phone, osint-domain, osint-origin · Public sink: domain_emails, domain_whois, instagram_profile, gravatar_email, osint-email · Destructive: substack_lookup, br_cpf

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
